spans.s:
Śeva-dhi denotes ‘treasure’ in the Rigveda and later.
Foot notes ii. 13, 6; vii. 53, 5; ix. 3, 15 (metaphorically). Cf. viii. 52, 9.
Av. v. 22, 14; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xviii. 59, etc.

Śevṛdha and Śevṛdhaka are the names of snakes or demons in the Atharvaveda.
Foot notes ii. 24, 1. Cf. Whitney Translation of the Atharvaveda, 64.
